title: Mystic Orb in the Storm
description: A woman in flowing white and blue robes stands barefoot on a wet stone pier, arms outstretched toward a large glowing orb of swirling blue, purple, and pink energy. Three children in similar robes run toward the orb as a swirling vortex of leaves, birds, and dark figures spirals into the dramatic, rainy sky over a body of water.
prompt: A mystical woman in flowing white and blue robes stands on a rainy stone pier beside a traditional building, reaching toward a large glowing orb of swirling cosmic energy in blues and purples. Three children in robes run toward the orb as a swirling vortex of leaves, birds, and shadowy figures spirals dramatically across a stormy sky with orange and pink clouds over a dark body of water, heavy rain falling, ethereal fantasy scene
